$comment: Closed-form equilibrium of the AI Layoff Trap (Falk & Tsoukalas 2026, arXiv 2603.20617). Mirrors crates/bwm-models-layoff-trap/src/equilibrium.rs. n must be >= 1 — the n = 0 degenerate case is handled at the contract level by a separate run.

equations.name: alpha_co
equations.expr: if(k == 0, if(s > ell, 1, 0), clamp((s - ell) / k, 0, 1))

equations.name: alpha_ne
equations.expr: if(k == 0, if(s > ell / n, 1, 0), clamp((s - ell / n) / k, 0, 1))

equations.name: demand
equations.expr: A + lambda * w * L * n * (1 - (1 - eta) * alpha_ne)

equations.name: per_firm_profit_ne
equations.expr: pi0 + L * (s * alpha_ne - ell * alpha_ne - (k / 2) * alpha_ne * alpha_ne)

equations.name: per_firm_profit_co
equations.expr: pi0 + L * (s * alpha_co - ell * alpha_co - (k / 2) * alpha_co * alpha_co)
